title: Purdue Engineering students use AI to tackle societal challenges in ShahLab.AI competition
summary_en: Seven Purdue Engineering student teams presented AI-driven solutions to real-world social and economic challenges on Oct. 21 during Phase 2 of the 2026 ShahLab.AI: AI For Social Good competition.
